topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session by connecting it to earlier histopathology practicals and outlining the day's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Cellular Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the historical investigation of transforming viruses identified cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to assess cellular transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, Tumor Suppressors, and Cell Cycle Control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes and illustrate their effects on cell cycle checkpoints and cellular phenotype.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Genetic Instability and Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular pathways and cellular failures that generate sequence and chromosomal instability, and demonstrate how this instability accelerates stepwise tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer onset and influence subsequent tumor evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by reviewing the learning outcomes, offering to take questions, and recommending further reading.
